evidence.excerpt: Janković is particularly interested in working with companies that have digitised their pattern libraries and can share polygon data; he is less suited to projects requiring physical prototyping or hardware development. He has supervised five completed Ph.D. theses and currently has capacity for one additional doctoral student.
